mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.first_name, s.last_name, s.email, s.opt_lock_version, c.id as c_id, c.title as c_title, c.credits as c_credits FROM student s LEFT JOIN student_course sc ON sc.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id = sc.course_id WHERE s.id = #{id}

SELECT s.id, s.first_name, s.last_name, s.email, s.opt_lock_version, u.id as u_id, u.name as u_name, u.city as u_city, c.id as c_id, c.title as c_title, c.credits as c_credits FROM student s LEFT JOIN university u ON u.id = s.university_id LEFT JOIN student_course sc ON sc.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id = sc.course_id ORDER BY s.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student (first_name, last_name, email) VALUES (#{firstName}, #{lastName}, #{email})
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.first_name, s.last_name, s.email, s.opt_lock_version, u.id as u_id, u.name as u_name, u.city as u_city, c.id as c_id, c.title as c_title, c.credits as c_credits FROM student s LEFT JOIN university u ON u.id = s.university_id LEFT JOIN student_course sc ON sc.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id = sc.course_id WHERE s.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM student WHERE first_name = #{firstName} AND last_name = #{lastName}
mapper.update: UPDATE student SET first_name = #{firstName}, last_name = #{lastName}, email = #{email}, university_id = #{university.id}, opt_lock_version = opt_lock_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND opt_lock_version = #{optLockVersion}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM student_course WHERE student_id = #{id}; DELETE FROM student WHERE id = #{id}
